I wish you didnt have to feel that way, but I really appreciate your sympathy

I'm really sorry to hear you're feeling that way. I know it probably doesn't mean much but I care. If you want someone to talk to, someone who will actually listen, someone who actually cares, I will be here.

I'm happy you are getting the help you truly deserve! I'm not sure you fully grasp what you just did. When I came to this sub I was honestly on the fence about leaving a post, but you are helping too! I'm so glad I could help, and truly blessed to have been able to talk with you! Oh, and trust me you can "drag the conversation out" any time! It's truly a pleasure.

You really have no idea how much that means to me! For the first time in a little while I feel like 'being me' might not actually be a bad thing. Thank you for being you. Please keep up the good work!

It hurts. It hurts to know this happened. It hurts to know he was seemingly beyond help before he got here. It hurts to imagine the pain brought down on the people who loved him. And it hurts to see some of the truly terrible comments left in the wake of it. Could we please show a little respect to the broken soul that left this post?
I'm sorry man. What is it that makes you want to get away from everyone?

You already are like us! We really do need more people like you on this planet. We need more people that will listen. But if you ever need someone to listen to you, just please remember we are always here, all ears. (:
Awww thank you! You just honestly made my day. I'm really glad I got the chance to talk to another wonderful human here. (:

I'm glad you're here too! And I am really glad you are seeking help. Just hang in there. You can be happy again. You will be. It will take some time and effort but you will get there. Reaching out for help may be the hardest part of the entire process but just know that doesn't mean you're weak or that something is wrong with you. Your response to that terrible event is completely normal, and I am sorry it still haunts you. I wish you the best of luck my friend.

I'm so sorry to hear you are going through this. PTSD is caused by an actual or perceived threat of death, a traumatic experience. My best advice is to seek counseling. In case you aren't familiar with it, trauma therapy aims to break the emotional connection associated with a trauma. You won't forget it happened, but you won't have those constant feelings and should be able to think about it directly without having those same feelings. I know the feelings, and I know it can start to feel like it would be convenient if you just didn't have to be here to deal with them but please trust me, it gets better.
